user.title: Set up AirRadar
user.description: AirRadar monitors aircraft around your Home Assistant home location using ADSB.lol. The notification action is optional; for example `notify.mobile_app_my_phone`.

data_description.distance_km: An aircraft must be within this distance to trigger a passage.
data_description.altitude_m: An aircraft must be below this altitude to trigger a passage.
data_description.poll_interval: How often AirRadar queries ADSB.lol. 15 seconds is recommended.
data_description.notifications: Send a phone notification directly when a new passage is detected.
data_description.notify_service: Example: `notify.mobile_app_iphone`. Leave empty to use only the AirRadar event entity.

error.invalid_notify_service: Enter an action starting with `notify.` or leave this field empty.
